issues.description: The problem statement's UML and textual description conflict about the return type of messageOnMilk(): the Milkable interface in the UML is declared with a boolean return type and the textual instructions say it should return true/false, while the class diagrams for Seal and Goat in the same UML show messageOnMilk():String. The provided solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning String and Seal/Goat return String messages. This inconsistency (boolean vs String) in the specification will confuse students about which signature to implement and whether messageOnMilk should return a boolean success flag or a descriptive String.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification: decide whether messageOnMilk() should return a boolean or a descriptive String. Preferably update the problem statement UML and textual instructions to match the solution (messageOnMilk(): String with example messages like "Goat <name> is milked"), or if the pedagogical intent is boolean, update the solution and template to make Milkable.messageOnMilk() return boolean and adjust Seal/Goat implementations and tests accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement (UML and Part 2 description) describes Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning a boolean (true/false) indicating whether milking was successful, but the provided solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String and the implementations return textual messages (e.g., "Goat [name] is milked"). This mismatch between the specification and the solution creates confusion about the expected return type and behavior of the same conceptual method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and implementation. Preferably update problem_statement.md (UML and Part 2 text) to state that Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a String describing the milking result (e.g., "Goat [name] is milked") to match the solution, or alternatively change the solution interface and implementations to return boolean and update all implementations and example usages accordingly.
